The files in Sources/SSHProxyCodec/NIOSOCKS are the unmodified Messages directory from Apple swift-nio-extras 1.35.3, commit 4858e3120f71175373f835181b437116021c4c6e. Only the SOCKS message codec links into the app. Network.framework retains ownership of the listener and its connection lifetime. SSHProxyCodec exposes the internal incremental parser within this package and enforces the local SSH listener’s no-auth CONNECT policy. Update the upstream sources, NOTICE and license together. [Upstream directory](https://github.com/apple/swift-nio-extras/tree/1.35.3/Sources/NIOSOCKS/Messages)
